column2: No act or decision or proceeding of the Commission

column1: shall  be  invalidated  by  reason  only  of  the  existence  of  a
vacancy  among  the  members  or  of  any  defect  in  the
appointment of a member thereof.

column2: (1)  The  seal  of  the  Commission  shall  be  in  the

column1: custody of the Chairman of the Commission.

column2: (2) The seal of the Commission may be altered in such

column1: manner as may be determined by the Commission.

column2: (3) The seal of the Commission shall not be affixed to any

column1: instrument or document except in the presence of a member
of  the  Commission  and  the  Director-General  of  the
Commission or in the absence of the Director-General, in the
presence of any two members of the Commission, who shall
sign the instrument in token of their presence.

column2: The Commission shall be responsible and answerable

column1: to  Parliament  for  the  discharge  of  its  functions  under  the
provisions of this Act and shall forward to Parliament in each
calendar  year  reports  relating  to  its  activities  during  such
year, in accordance with the provisions of section 159 of this
Act.

column2: (1) The quorum of the Commission to exercise its

column1: powers  and  discharge  its  functions  under  section  41  and
subsection (1) of section 65 shall be two members.

column2: (2) The quorum of the Commission to exercise any power

column1: or discharge any function under this Act other than the powers
and functions specified under section 41 and subsection (1)
of section 65, shall be three members and in the event of any
disagreement, the majority decision shall prevail.
